press_references.value: Sumou signs management contract with Arsh Real Estate

partnership_announcements.description: Sumou Real Estate signed a 36‑month project development management contract with Arsh Real Estate for Arsh Real Estate Fund 3, under which Sumou will manage all development stages of a mixed‑use project in Jeddah in return for management, marketing and brokerage fees tied to project costs and sales.

press_references.value: Sumou, KHC units sign Riyadh land development, sales deal

partnership_announcements.description: Sumou Real Estate and Kingdom Holding subsidiaries Kingdom Real Estate Development and Trade Center signed a 36-month exclusive agreement under which Sumou will manage infrastructure development and oversee marketing and sales of 3.07 million square meters of residential and commercial land in Riyadh, earning fees tied to project costs and sales.

press_references.value: Sumou signs SAR 423.4M tower development contract in Makkah

partnership_announcements.description: Sumou Real Estate signed a SAR 423.4 million contract with Areeb Advanced Real Estate to jointly develop, design, and construct a residential and commercial tower in Makkah for the Areeb Sumou Makkah Real Estate Fund.

press_references.value: Saudi: Sumou Real Estate inks development agreement for Anara project

partnership_announcements.description: Sumou Real Estate signed a development management agreement with Maali AlJazira Real Estate Company, representing AlJazira Sumou Real Estate Fund, to manage the Anara project in Riyadh (753 residential units on a 748,022 sqm plot). The 36‑month contract starts after licensing by the Real Estate General Authority, with Sumou entitled to SAR 76.6 million in fees (10% of estimated project costs).
